dataset: CAMELYON16 (Computational Pathology Group, Radboud University Medical Center, Nijmegen; AWS Open Data mirror)
deidentified: Public challenge data set of de-identified sentinel lymph node H&E sections; only WSI pixel data is used, the embedded macro photograph is never read.
stain: H&E, sentinel lymph node with breast-carcinoma macrometastasis (CAMELYON16 'Tumor' annotation group)
scanner: 3DHistech Pannoramic 250 Flash II (DICOM_MANUFACTURER in the Philips TIFF header), exported as Philips-style BigTIFF by ASAP
sourceCompression: JPEG q80, YCbCr 4:2:0, 512x512 tiles with shared JPEGTables (so the chroma is already subsampled 2x2 in the source)
